Dialogs.Dialog: Hey, hey, shall we get going？
This is the place. We're here.
I might be a little tired...
...Time moves strangely on dates, doesn't it.
Ah, already time to go home？ That really went fast.
Um... you know, I don't want to tell you, but... look at the clock.
Ah. We should head home soon.
Yeah, we should head home soon.
Any later and it'll be too late.
Right. It's time to go home.
I want to stay a little longer, but I have to go home.
Any later and Papa might get mad.
Is that enough？ We'll run out of time.
Sorry. I'd better get you home.
I'm counting on your choice, I guess.
Show me how reliable you are.
I can't decide. Hey, where do you want to go？
You haven't decided where to go？
We can't just stay here forever, you know？
Got it, I'll decide right now.
This is getting fun. What next？
It really is nice, being together. Hey, what should we do after this？
What should we do after this, I wonder...
Then let's go somewhere else too.
Hey, are we still staying here？
Let's see, I'll leave this one to you？
Got it. Leave it to me.
Which movie should we see... Any recommendations？
Hey, which do you recommend？ Let's see that one？
Let's see the one you want to see？
Um... I can't decide. Pass the baton.
All right, leave it to me.
Any is fine. Go ahead, choose.
Do you still have time？ Would it be okay to see one more？
That was a good one. Now I'm curious about the other movies too.
Proposal. Let's make today a movie marathon day？
I'm curious about the others too... Hey, want to watch one more？
I'd like to see another one too... if that's okay with you.
True, I'm in the mood for one more...
It's not quite enough. Shall we see another movie？
Hmm, all right, let's do it？
Hehe, we match. I want to go there too.
I wonder if it's fun there.
There？ ...Well, we won't know unless we go.
Ooh, good timing. I was just getting hungry.
Maybe it's time for lunch... Ah, not that I'm hungry... Um, maybe a little.
Hey, aren't you hungry？ I might be, a little.
Already that time？ Shall we go, then？
Oh, you're right. Let's have lunch.
Hey, aren't you forgetting something？ The time.
I'm thirsty. Let's have tea around here and rest？
I'd like to sit down and talk for a while...
Ah, then want to have tea？
Hey, want to take a break？ Over some tea.
Sorry. My feet might be a little tired.
Then let's take a break over some tea.
I'd like to take a break soon. Okay？
I'd like to have dinner with you tonight. Okay？
It's time to eat... but I still want to be with you.
After this, it's dinner for two... right？
Hey, aren't you hungry？ I am, a little.
Me too. Then let's eat before we go.
It's about time to eat. I'm hungry. How about you？
We still have time to eat before going home.
We're here. Have you decided what to eat？
I'm totally starving. I bet everything will taste great.
Maybe I'll try something different from usual？
I told them I might be late today...
Are you going home just like that？ I still want to be with you...
I want... to be with you longer. Can't I？
I don't want to go home yet...
Our date isn't over yet, right？
Then, how about we keep going？
All right, let's have a bit more fun.
If it's okay with you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, I'm free too.
Thank you for granting my wish.
It's getting late. Let's go home.
Yes, I want to go there too.
Sorry, I didn't think about the distance...
Hey. Getting there would take a while.
To get there... we might have to run full speed？
Ah, a bit too far, huh.
That's... sorry, let's go home after all？
Hmm, sorry, let's skip it after all？
